name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - Après le § 3 - Am 70
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 3a. Recalls the conclusions of Special Report No. 18/2025 of the European Court of Auditors (ECA) on the Union’s budgetary flexibility; emphasises that the identification and analysis of needs have been insufficient, that the current framework remains too complex due to the proliferation of overlapping instruments and the lack of a clearly established order of use, and that certain tools were systematically exhausted during the first years of the MFF, thereby reducing their availability for subsequent years; calls on the Commission to simplify the flexibility framework, clarify existing instruments, and enhance transparency and documentation regarding the choices made when mobilising margins or special instruments, in accordance with the recommendations made by the Court of Auditors;
